summary:
Done. All component tests pass (25/26; the one failure is the pre-existing `TutorialService` spec, which I left untouched since it isn't a component test and the service is out of scope).

**What I changed:**

1. **`src/app/components/header/`** (new) — `HeaderComponent` with an indigo→purple gradient navbar, a "TM" mark + "Tutorial Manager" logo, and "Tutorials" / "Add Tutorial" links highlighted via `routerLinkActive`; declared in `AppModule`. `app.component.html` now renders `<app-header>`, the routed content, and a simple footer (`app.component.css`).
2. **Tutorials list** — responsive grid of rounded cards with soft shadows that lift on hover, each with the title, a two-line clamped description, and a green **Published** / amber **Pending** pill; a rounded search bar on top, a friendly empty state with a book icon, and a red pill "Remove All" button.
3. **Add / Edit pages** — centered rounded cards, rounded inputs with an indigo focus glow, right-aligned action rows, and success messages rendered as Bootstrap `alert alert-success` (the edit page's `{{ message }}` paragraph became a conditional alert).
4. **Global** — Inter linked in `src/index.html`; `src/styles.css` now holds the shared design tokens (colors, radius, shadows, transitions) and reusable `tm-card` / `tm-btn` / `tm-input` / `tm-pill` / `tm-empty` classes used by every component, on a light grey page background.

Tests updated: `header.component.spec.ts` (new), `app.component.spec.ts` (replaced the stale `angular-17-crud` title/h1 assertions with header+footer rendering), `tutorials-list` (card/pill and empty-state cases, drawer click now targets `.tutorial-card`), `add-tutorial` and `tutorial-details` (added the missing `HttpClientTestingModule`/`FormsModule`/`RouterTestingModule` they needed and asserted the new card + alert markup).

Reading taken: visual-only — no service, routing, or component logic was touched, and `angular.json`/`package.json` are unchanged (Bootstrap 4 and NgModule kept). Nothing here belonged to the backend repository.
blockers: Not applied -- Fixing the failing TutorialService spec (missing HttpClient provider): Pre-existing failure in a service spec, not a component test; services were explicitly out of scope
Not applied -- Restyling the tutorial drawer: Not named in the request; left alone to keep the diff proportionate

visual_check.evidence: Both /tutorials and /add render the new indigo-to-purple gradient navbar with the 'Tutorial Manager' logo, active-link highlight, and a footer; the list page shows a rounded search bar, red 'Remove All' button and a friendly empty state (no backend data, so cards couldn't be shown), and /add shows a centered rounded card with rounded inputs and an aligned Submit button, all on a light grey background in the Inter font. Only nit: the emoji/icon glyphs in the search field and empty state render as tofu boxes in the headless browser.

endpoints.purpose: Update a tutorial or toggle its published flag

context_sharing.notes: All service paths in src/app/services/tutorial.service.ts are relative ('/tutorials'); ApiInterceptor (src/app/interceptors/api.interceptor.ts) prefixes environment.apiUrl ('http://localhost:5001/api') to any non-absolute URL, so the effective base is http://localhost:5001/api. Every Tutorial field is optional in the model, `id` is declared `any`, and createdAt/updatedAt are declared as strings (not date objects); the changed files are UI/CSS/template-only and add no new endpoints. Client routes are /tutorials, /tutorials/:id and /add.
